newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom says restarts hedging program.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom says restarts hedging program.

text.p: Canadian copper miner Rio Algom Ltd said on Thursday it reinstituted its copper hedging program.
"While we remain relatively bullish on copper prices, we have reinstituted our hedging program," Rio Algom Chief Financial Officer Michael Parrett said during a conference call with analysts.
Parrett said Rio Algom put protection for all of its fourth-quarter settlements and some first-quarter settlements at a strike price of US$1 for a premium of US$0.02 per pound.
"We're continuing to monitor the markets for further opportunities to hedge further out into 1998," he said.
